gaps: DAEMON_DEFAULT_MAX_TASKS_CONTRACT_GAP
Persistent daemon defaults MaxTasks to 8 and passes that value to the scan runner, while the canonical slot contract requires max_tasks_per_scan=1.
Set and validate MaxTasks=1 in the daemon, launcher, request, queue and runtime receipt.
DAEMON_MAX_TASKS_RANGE_VALIDATION_GAP
Daemon accepts an arbitrary integer MaxTasks without a positive upper-bound check.
Reject values other than the canonical single-task limit before lock acquisition.
DAEMON_CORRUPT_LOCK_FAIL_OPEN_GAP
Read-Json swallows lock parse errors and returns null; the daemon then treats the lock as absent and can remove it while an existing daemon is alive.
Treat unreadable or schema-invalid locks as blocked until exact PID/start/executable identity is safely resolved.
DAEMON_LOCK_PROCESS_IDENTITY_FALLBACK_GAP
When command-line lookup fails, daemon lock validation falls back to any powershell-like process name.
Require executable path, script blob, command-line hash, repo root, branch and process start time; no process-name fallback.
DAEMON_WORKER_EXECUTION_TIMEOUT_GAP
Supervisor waits for the scan worker without an overall worker timeout while continuing to publish fresh daemon heartbeat.
Bound each scan-worker invocation and record fail-closed timeout plus descendant cleanup.
DAEMON_GIT_REFRESH_TIMEOUT_GAP
Daemon Invoke-Git has no bounded process timeout for fetch, status or pull refresh operations.
Run every Git operation through a bounded process-tree helper with timeout receipts.
DAEMON_SCAN_RUNNER_BLOB_PIN_GAP
Daemon checks only that the scan-runner file exists before repeated execution; no expected blob is pinned.
Pin the scan-runner blob across launcher, request, status and daemon receipt before every launch.
DAEMON_SITE_LAUNCHER_BLOB_PIN_GAP
Site watchdog executes START_TERRAYIELD_PORTABLE_8012.ps1 after an existence check only.
Pin launcher bytes, executable identity and invocation nonce before recovery.
DAEMON_SLOT_SPECIFIC_SITE_ACCEPTANCE_GAP
Watchdog checks a generic health endpoint and an unrelated ready-to-sell page, not the height_difference_2 manifest and exact row bindings.
Probe the slot page, manifest integrity and exact three candidate bindings before reporting slot site health.
DAEMON_STALE_WORKER_STATUS_REPLAY_GAP
Heartbeat imports reusable MULTI_PAGE_latest_status fields without binding worker PID, run_id, instance_id or freshness.
Accept worker status only from the current worker generation and bounded timestamp window.
DAEMON_NONCANONICAL_PORT_PROCESS_PRESERVE_GAP
When port 8012 is occupied by a live noncanonical process, watchdog preserves it and cannot recover the canonical site.
Record an explicit blocker and require operator-safe identity resolution instead of silent indefinite preservation.
DAEMON_LOCK_HEARTBEAT_STRICT_DURABILITY_GAP
Daemon lock, heartbeat and status JSON use permissive ConvertTo-Json and replacement without schema validation or disk flush.
Use strict schema-bound JSON, unique temporary files, flush-to-disk and atomic replacement.
SCAN_LOCK_CORRUPT_FAIL_OPEN_GAP
Scan runner removes an unreadable or invalid lock because Read-JsonFile returns null, even if the referenced worker may still be alive.
Fail closed on lock parse/schema errors and independently resolve PID/start/executable identity.
SCAN_LOCK_EXECUTABLE_COMMAND_IDENTITY_GAP
Scan lock validation checks PID, start time and scope but not executable path, command line, repo root or work root.
Bind all recorded process and root identity fields before accepting or removing a lock.
SCAN_MAX_TASKS_RANGE_VALIDATION_GAP
Scan runner selects First MaxTasks and loops until MaxTasks without enforcing the canonical one-task ceiling.
Require MaxTasks exactly 1 for production mode and reject zero, negative or larger values.
SCAN_GIT_COMMAND_TIMEOUT_GAP
Invoke-AaysGit executes Git synchronously without a bounded timeout or descendant cleanup.
Use the bounded Git wrapper for fetch, show, worktree, commit and push operations.
SCAN_REMOTE_ORIGIN_IDENTITY_GAP
Queue mirror and task worktrees trust origin and the requested branch without pinning repository identity.
Verify canonical origin URL/repository ID and fetched commit before reading queue blobs or pushing.
SCAN_TASK_RUNTIME_UPPER_BOUND_GAP
Task max_runtime_seconds is parsed and only lower-bounded; an arbitrarily large value can retain a claim indefinitely.
Enforce a contract-defined finite upper bound and reject overflow or out-of-range values.
SCAN_TASK_PROCESS_TREE_TIMEOUT_CLEANUP_GAP
Automation timeout stops only the direct PowerShell child PID and does not prove descendant termination.
Use a Windows Job Object or equivalent tree contract and verify all descendants are gone.
SCAN_REMOTE_CLAIM_HEARTBEAT_PUBLICATION_GAP
The worker updates claim and heartbeat files every five seconds locally, but the observed loop contains no remote Push-Sync until terminal publication.
Publish bounded remote lease renewals or use an authoritative external lease store with CAS and freshness receipts.
